title: Expanding Attention: A Taylor-Series Route to Linear-Time Transformers with a Fixed Number of Recurrent States
abstract: arXiv:2610.20637v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We expand the exponential kernel of attention into a truncated Taylor series of $n$ terms and factorize each term into a tensor-power inner product, which collapses the causal history into exactly $n$ recurrent states, each updated by one rank-one outer product per token and independent of context length $N$. The recursion is lossless with respect to the truncated kernel ($2.2 \times 10^{-16}$ in float64), and the states are additive across chunks ($5.7 \times 10^{-14}$), so prefill admits a parallel scan. Measured exponents are $t \propto N^{2.28}$ for softmax against $N^{0.91}$ for states, with a crossover at $N \approx 728$ and $20.8\times$ at $N = 8192$; per-token decoding latency is constant at $7.3\,\mu$s against $N^{1.04}$ for softmax, giving $76.0\times$ at $N = 65536$. Accuracy improves exponentially in $n$ while cost grows combinatorially, since the $m$-th state is $\binom{d+m-1}{m}$ wide---a bound confirmed by SVD---so the opt

translated_title: 扩展注意力：通向具有固定数量循环状态的线性时间Transformer的泰勒级数路径
translated_abstract: 我们将注意力的指数核展开为n项的截断泰勒级数，并将每一项分解为张量幂内积，从而将因果历史压缩为恰好n个循环状态，每个状态由每个token一次秩一外积进行更新，且与上下文长度N无关。该递归相对于截断核是无损的（float64下误差为2.2×10⁻¹⁶），且各状态在不同数据块之间满足可加性（误差5.7×10⁻¹⁴），因此预填充阶段可以采用并行扫描。实测时间复杂度指数显示softmax为t ∝ N²·²⁸，而状态方法为N⁰·⁹¹，交叉点位于N ≈ 728处，在N = 8192时加速20.8倍；每个token的解码延迟恒定为7.3微秒，而softmax为N¹·⁰⁴，在N = 65536时加速76.0倍。精度随n呈指数提升，而计算成本按组合数增长，因为第m个状态的宽度为C(d+m-1, m)——该上界已由SVD验证。
tldr: 该论文提出将注意力的指数核展开为截断泰勒级数并分解为张量幂内积，把因果历史无损压缩为固定数量n个循环状态，从而实现线性时间Transformer，在长上下文下获得最高数十倍加速且解码延迟恒定。
en_tdlr: This paper expands attention's exponential kernel into a truncated Taylor series factorized into tensor-power inner products, collapsing causal history into a fixed number of n recurrent states updated by rank-one outer products, achieving lossless linear-time Transformers with constant per-token decoding latency and up to 76× speedups at long context lengths.
